run_eval_metric: run eval_metric.py to evaluate detection results saved in pickle format against a dataset
run_eval_metric_bbox: run eval_metric.py with --eval bbox to compute bounding box metrics on COCO results
run_eval_metric_format_only: run eval_metric.py with --format-only to format results for submission without evaluation
run_eval_metric_mAP: run eval_metric.py with --eval mAP to compute mean average precision on PASCAL VOC results
run_eval_metric_cfg_options: run eval_metric.py with --cfg-options to override config settings during evaluation
